Marissa / Rachel — following up from Friday’s call with Mednexa. Notes and preliminary sizing below (I've attached an initial cost worksheet and cluster diagram):

Customer stated steady-state ~60 reqs/s across production with 8–10s peak bursts to ~180 reqs/s. Latency SLO target is p95 < 400ms for single-turn requests. They require network isolation (VPC peering + routing restrictions) and a separate KMS key per environment.

Sizing recommendation (initial):
- 2x isolated private clusters, each configured as: 4x A100-80GB equivalent (4x worker nodes), 2x control-plane nodes
- Initial quantization profile: 4-bit for non-critical models, full fp16 for critical clinical flows
- Additional cache capacity per-cluster: 250GB KV cache

Estimated incremental list costs (monthly):
- Cluster Opex (per cluster): $43,000
- Managed private control plane: $5,000
- Isolation/ops uplift: $3,200
- One-time onboarding & migration: $28,000

Total incremental ARR impact (two clusters + ops uplift): $106,400/mo (not including volume discounts or committed reserved pricing).

I attached: Mednexa_proposal_v1.pdf (draft amendment) and cluster_sizing.xlsx. We should push a reserved 12- or 24-month commit to reduce unit cost — Marissa, can you flag recommended discount band?

Dev
